subject: Intro + next steps: economic buyer & procurement - Nova Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Turner <jacob.turner@novasystems.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call - next steps & economic buyer intro

Hi Jacob - thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Recap:
- Goal: reduce query latency for your customer-facing agents and cut token cost on high-volume endpoints.
- Key technical constraints: 4-6k average prompt length, live-update requirements, and SSO requirements for the admin console.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency SLOs, per-token unit economics, and data residency for EU customers.

Ask/next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner and the primary procurement contact at Nova Systems? We want to loop them in so we can align on commercial terms and procurement timeline.
2) I'm attaching the call notes and our initial pricing workbook for your internal review (see attachments).
3) If it makes sense, we'd love a 20-30 minute intro with the economic buyer + procurement this week to run through value, expected ROI, and PO/contract mechanics.

Suggested times (PDT): Thu 5/13 10:00-10:30, Thu 5/13 15:00-15:30, Fri 5/14 09:00-09:30. If none of these work, send a few slots that do.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20270512.pdf (call notes)

Thanks - I'll coordinate once I have the right contacts.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Jacob Turner <jacob.turner@novasystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call - next steps & economic buyer intro

Thanks Marissa - great summary. A few quick answers from my side:

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Asha Mehta (VP, Platform & Data): asha.mehta@novasystems.com
- CFO (final sign-off): Sanjay Rao (sanjay.rao@novasystems.com) - typically signs larger spend but Asha will own the evaluation and vendor recommendation.
- Procurement / legal: Lara Chen (lara.chen@novasystems.com) and our shared procurement alias procurement@novasystems.com

We'd like to see a short SOW and a pricing range before the intro if possible - helps Asha/finance triage quickly. Can you send a one-page SOW + ballpark numbers?

I'll introduce Asha and Lara on the thread once I confirm their availability. Either Thu afternoon or Fri morning should work for them.


Jacob Turner
Head of Engineering - Conversational Products
Jacob.Turner@novasystems.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novasystems.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@novasystems.com>
Cc: Jacob Turner <jacob.turner@novasystems.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + short SOW & pricing (proposed times) - Redwood x Nova Systems

Hi Asha & Lara - Jacob kindly offered to loop you in. Nice to e-meet you. As discussed with Jacob, I wanted to share a very short draft SOW and our initial pricing ranges so you have context before a brief intro call.

What I'm attaching:
- one-page draft SOW (purpose, scope, timeline, milestones)
- initial pricing workbook (ballpark consumption and reserved capacity examples)

Quick notes:
- Typical rollout we recommend for customers of your size: pilot (1-2 weeks, prod-like traffic), then 3-month reserved footprint to stabilize latency and unit costs.
- Primary value levers we'll measure: per-token cost reduction, latency P50/P95, and expected error/regression rates.

Proposed times (PDT): Fri 5/14 09:00-09:30, Mon 5/17 10:00-10:30, Tue 5/18 08:30-09:00. Please let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-nova-20270513.xlsx, draft-sow-nova-20270518.docx

If helpful I can also surface a short ROI example tied to your current token volumes - would you like that for the call?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Jacob Turner <jacob.turner@novasystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novasystems.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@novasystems.com>
Cc: procurement@novasystems.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + short SOW & pricing (proposed times) - Redwood x Nova Systems

Marissa - thanks for the SOW and pricing. Asha and Lara are available Tue 5/18 09:00-09:30 PDT (we booked the slot).

A couple of quick clarifications before the call:
- Finance / budget: Sanjay Rao (CFO) is the budget owner. He typically needs an internal ROI and a cost estimate to approve any reserved commit. Asha will own vendor selection and recommendation to Sanjay.
- Procurement: Lara will drive contract steps, but please include the PO flow and any standard terms we should expect (data residency/SSO/SLA).

Please bring a one-page ROI and a clear outline of procurement/PO steps to the call. If you can circulate the finalized SOW and a clean pricing sheet ahead of the meeting, procurement will triage faster.

Thanks - looking forward to the call.
